usageNotes: Permanently deletes a resource pool from the cluster. The pool must be empty — all VMs, containers, and storage entries must be removed from the pool before deletion will succeed. Requires the Pool.Allocate privilege on /pool/{poolid}.
destructiveReason: Permanently removes the pool definition from the cluster; this action cannot be undone and any ACL entries scoped to /pool/{poolid} are also deleted.
tips: The API returns null on success — absence of error is the confirmation.
Remove all member resources (VMs, CTs, storage) via update_pools before attempting deletion; a non-empty pool returns a 400 error.
Pool-scoped permission grants (user ACLs on /pool/{poolid}) are automatically cleaned up when the pool is deleted.
